title: Budgeting 45 minutes: a first timed walkthrough

kcs.statement: A workable 45-minute budget is roughly 5 min requirements, 5 min estimates, 5 min API and data model, 10–15 min high-level design, 10–15 min deep dive and bottlenecks, with a few minutes for questions.
Announcing each transition ('requirements are set, now estimates') keeps the interviewer aligned and lets them redirect time before it is lost.

problem_ideas: A candidate reaches the diagram at minute 28: identify where time leaked and re-budget
Allocate a 35-minute variant of the budget and say which step shrinks
Write the one-sentence signposts for each transition in a URL shortener answer
Interviewer says 'skip estimates': redistribute the freed minutes
Run a 10-minute speed version of a Pastebin answer covering requirements to diagram
Judge two transcripts: which kept the interviewer in control of depth?
